findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_title_search, get_order_status, rest_api_info, building_records_lookup, superfund_sites_near_address, tax_appeal_deadlines, property_history_lookup, surplus_funds_search, surplus_funds_summary, tax_sale_search, tax_sale_summary, create_property_watch · Private data: list_coverage, check_coverage, check_address, order_title_search, get_report, get_sample_report, rest_api_info, building_records_lookup, llc_owner_lookup, nyc_landlord_lookup, ucc_lien_search, superfund_sites_near_address, superfund_sites_by_state, radon_lookup, radon_by_county, tax_appeal_deadlines, order_tax_appeal_evidence, property_history_lookup, tax_sale_search, property_watch_coverage, create_property_watch · Public sink: order_title_search, building_records_lookup, llc_owner_lookup, radon_lookup, recent_sales, tax_sale_search, create_property_watch · Destructive: opportunity_zone_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_title_search, get_order_status, rest_api_info, building_records_lookup, superfund_sites_near_address, tax_appeal_deadlines, property_history_lookup, surplus_funds_search, surplus_funds_summary, tax_sale_search, tax_sale_summary, create_property_watch · Private data: list_coverage, check_coverage, check_address, order_title_search, get_report, get_sample_report, rest_api_info, building_records_lookup, llc_owner_lookup, nyc_landlord_lookup, ucc_lien_search, superfund_sites_near_address, superfund_sites_by_state, radon_lookup, radon_by_county, tax_appeal_deadlines, order_tax_appeal_evidence, property_history_lookup, tax_sale_search, property_watch_coverage, create_property_watch · Public sink: order_title_search, building_records_lookup, llc_owner_lookup, radon_lookup, recent_sales, tax_sale_search, create_property_watch · Destructive: opportunity_zone_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
